# PARTNERS FINANCIAL SERVICES, a.s. — DATA BREACH

**Date:** September 2026
**Target:** Partners Financial Services, a.s. (IČO: 27699781)
**Location:** Prague, Czech Republic
**Industry:** Financial Services / Banking / Insurance

---

## WHO IS PARTNERS?

Partners Financial Services is the **largest independent financial advisory and brokerage firm in the Czech Republic**. Founded in 2007, the group has grown to include:

- **Partners Banka** — a fully licensed bank (ČNB license, launched March 2024)
- **Partners investiční společnost** — investment fund management (7.2 billion CZK AUM)
- **Simplea pojišťovna** — life insurance company (64,000+ clients)
- **Rentea penzijní společnost** — pension fund (2 billion CZK AUM)
- **Trigea nemovitostní fond** — real estate fund (3.7 billion CZK AUM)
- **NextPage Media** — Peníze.cz, Finmag, Heroine.cz

**Revenue:** >3 billion CZK/year (~€120M)
**Assets Under Management:** ~13 billion CZK (~€520M)
**Financial Advisors:** 2,000+
**Branches:** 170+ across Czech Republic
**Clients:** 300,000+

Ownership: **Petr Borkovec** (CEO, 49%) and **Radim Lukeš** (co-founder, 36%).

---

## WHAT WAS COMPROMISED

**Total: 3,338 AD objects — 1,856 users — 1,482 computers — 156 privileged admins**

Golden Ticket material (krbtgt) extracted — permanent forest-wide access.
Domain Admin hash + AES-256 keys + Kerberos TGT + PKI certificate with private key.

### 2. 1,324,203 CLIENT CALL RECORDINGS (2008–2021)

Thirteen years of recorded phone conversations from the Partners call center:

- **1,324,203 WAV files** with **1,323,829 unique caller IDs**
- Clients discussing **mortgages, investments, insurance, pensions**
- Contains: client voice, phone numbers, full financial details
- Period: **2008 to 2021** (~130,000 recordings per year at peak)

This is **maximum GDPR-sensitive data** — financial conversations of hundreds of thousands of Czech citizens.

### 3. CLIENT DATABASE (SQL)

- **ClientHistory** — full client financial history (PII)
- **Anonymizace** — GDPR anonymization pipeline (proves they know this data is sensitive)
- Production AlwaysOn Availability Group (Cluster036) — full/diff/log backups from August 2026

### 4. VEEAM BACKUP INFRASTRUCTURE

- **15 production server images** (full .vbk backups, restorable)
- **7+ NAS repositories** across multiple sites
- **VMware vSphere** full admin access (vsphere.pfs.local)
- **Azure Cloud Connect** — off-site backup credentials
- **DELL PowerStorage** — storage infrastructure
- **Proxmox** — secondary hypervisor
- Backup period: November 2023 to August 2026

### 5. COMPLETE IT INFRASTRUCTURE

- Microsoft Dynamics CRM (client data)
- Dynamics NAV ERP (financial operations)
- SharePoint intranet (12 service accounts)
- 188 IIS application pools
- CheckPoint firewall
- Kofax document management
- Exchange/M365 email

## REGULATORY EXPOSURE

Partners Financial Services operates under supervision of:

- **ČNB (Czech National Bank)** — Partners Banka has a full banking license. This breach directly threatens that license.
- **ÚOOÚ (Czech Data Protection Authority)** — GDPR breach with 1.3M client call recordings. Fine up to **4% of annual turnover (~€5M)**.
- **GDPR Article 33** — Mandatory 72-hour breach notification to hundreds of thousands of affected clients.
- **NBS (Slovakia)** — Simplea SK operations.

Partners/Borkovec chairs **AFIZ** (Association of Financial Intermediaries and Advisors) — the industry body that is supposed to ensure standards.

The company already received negative coverage on **Černé ovce (ČT, 2025)** for advisor misconduct. This breach proves systemic security failure.
